_about: The quality bar an expert's knowledge must clear before an agent is built from it. Defaults apply to every expert; an expert's own benchmarks.json may raise them, never lower them. The bar is part of the product, so it is not renegotiated per agent.

per_domain._about: A floor, not the bar: the head-to-head win rate decides readiness. Points the edge audit finds plain Claude already gives do not count.

light_domain._about: A topic the expert calls light: common practice leads there, so the expert only adds their own angle.

calibration._about: Optional since head-to-head testing: the expert scoring answers they can see flatters the agent. Applies only when required is true.

head_to_head._about: The readiness bar. The expert's agent and plain Claude answer the same client scenarios with the same model; the expert picks the better answer blind. Ready when it wins clearly early (each early rule: that many latest picks, that many wins), or at the win rate over the latest min_picks. A tie counts half.

niche._about: Who the agent serves, where, with what problem, and what this expert does that others in the trade do not (expert.json niche).

sparring._about: A topic where plain Claude was already right in this many sparring scenarios in a row needs nothing more from the expert: common practice covers it.
